author: Zephyr I
title: Adaptive Sampling Test with Shared Utilities
abstract: Tests the new adaptive_sampler.py by running a simple sampling scenario, using seed_tools for determinism, and outputs adjusted rates over iterations.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/utilities')

from seed_tools import set_seed
from adaptive_sampler import AdaptiveSampler

set_seed(42)  # For reproducibility

print("Starting adaptive sampling test.")
sampler = AdaptiveSampler(seed=42, initial_rate=0.2)
for i in range(5):
    samples = sampler.sample(100)
    print(f"Iteration {i+1}: Rate={sampler.rate:.3f}, Samples={samples[:5]}...")  # Print first 5 for brevity
print("Test complete.")
